description: This file initializes and configures the regional settings for the jQuery UI datepicker plugin for English (UK) locale. It defines labels and formats specific to the en-GB region.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory function for registering the module, supports AMD and browser globals.

methods.name: define
methods.description: AMD define function for module registration.

methods.name: datepicker.regional[ "en-GB" ]
methods.description: Object containing regional datepicker settings for en-GB locale.

methods.name: datepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Sets the default regional settings for the datepicker.
